policy_sales_final:
All purchases are final. We do not accept returns for change of mind, wrong size, color preference, or buyer's remorse.
Exceptions are made only for defective or damaged items. Please refer to our Returns Policy below.
policy_returns:
Returns Accepted Only for Defective Items
We accept returns only if the item is defective, damaged during shipping, or significantly different from the product description.

You must contact us within 7 days of delivery by emailing our support team.
All return requests must be sent to: [Your Support Email]
Returns without prior approval will not be accepted.
Customers are responsible for return shipping costs.
Refunds or replacements are issued only after we receive and inspect the item.

No returns for:

Change of mind
Incorrect size or color selection
Used or worn items
Fragrance products (hygiene reasons)
policy_shipping:
Shipping Information

Orders are processed within 1–3 business days.
Standard shipping time is 7–14 business days within the United States.
International orders may take 14–28 days.
A tracking number will be sent to your email once your order ships.
We are not responsible for delays caused by shipping carriers.

Note: Shipping times may be longer during busy periods.
policy_support:
Customer Support
Support is available via email only.

Email: [Your Support Email]
Response time: Within 24–48 business hours (Monday – Friday)
Please include your Order ID in every email for faster help.

We can assist with:

Order tracking
Product questions
Damaged or defective items
Return requests
policy_faq_1_a: All sales are final. If you have a real issue with your product, please contact customer support and we will do our best to help.
policy_faq_2_q: How do I contact customer support?
policy_faq_2_a: You can reach our support team via email or phone. Visit our contact section below or use the information provided on this page.
policy_faq_3_a: Yes. Orders are collected through the site's secure checkout form and stored in the admin panel for fulfillment.
policy_faq_4_a: We process orders quickly. Once shipped, delivery times depend on your location. You will receive a tracking number to monitor your order.
